hero.subtitle: Comfortable AC rooms, clean non-AC rooms, and a spacious group dormitory for pilgrim families and palkhis. Enjoy 24/7 hot water, free secure parking, and restful darshan stays.

about.title: A Clean & Peaceful Sanctuary for Pilgrims
about.desc1: Situated just 200 metres from the revered Shri Sant Balumama Temple in Admapur, Hotel Morya Lodging was created with devotion to offer pilgrims a spotless, peaceful, and warm stay.
about.desc2: Whether you are traveling as an individual devotee, a family with elders, or a large Palkhi group, our warm hospitality, 24/7 assistance, and peaceful rooms ensure you rest comfortably after darshan.
about.altFacade: Hotel Morya Lodging facade in Admapur
about.altLobby: Reception desk at Hotel Morya Lodging

temple.title: Just 200 Metres from Shri Sant Balumama Temple Gate
temple.subtitle: Step out of your room and reach the holy shrine within two minutes of leisurely walking.
temple.mahaprasadHours: Afternoon 11:30 AM to 3:00 PM | Night 7:30 PM to 10:00 PM
temple.haldiDesc: Experience the sacred saffron Bhandara blessing and peaceful atmosphere of Admapur.
temple.hlDistanceDesc: A relaxed 2-minute stroll from our lobby right to the temple mahadwar.
temple.hlAartiDesc: Attend early morning Kakad Aarti (5:30 AM) and evening Shej Aarti with zero transit delays.
temple.hlPrasadDesc: Conveniently located near the Sansthan Anna Chhatra (Mahaprasad dining hall).
temple.hlEldersDesc: Seniors can easily return to air-conditioned rooms to rest between rituals and darshan.

rooms.title: Clean, Restful Rooms for Devotees & Families
rooms.subtitle: Choose from cool AC rooms, economical non-AC rooms, or our spacious community dormitory. All rooms feature fresh linens, attached bathrooms, and continuous hot water.

amenities.title: Thoughtfully Designed for Pilgrim Comfort
amenities.subtitle: Everything you need for a worry-free spiritual retreat in Admapur.
amenities.hotWaterDesc: Geyser-heated hot water available round-the-clock for morning baths before early darshan.
amenities.parkingDesc: Spacious on-premises parking for personal cars, traveller vans, and pilgrim buses.
amenities.roWaterDesc: Hygienic RO drinking water available 24/7 across the lodge for safe hydration during your pilgrimage.
amenities.backupDesc: Full inverter & generator support ensuring uninterrupted light and fans.
amenities.cleanlinessDesc: Daily room sanitization, spotless bathrooms, and fresh laundered bedsheets.
amenities.templeProximityDesc: Located just 200m from the temple entrance, allowing multiple visits per day.
amenities.dormitoryDesc: Massive 50+ person shared accommodation for devotee sanghas, palkhis, and large family yatras.
amenities.receptionDesc: Round-the-clock front desk staff ready to welcome late arrivals and assist with local guidance.
amenities.safetyDesc: CCTV security and calm surroundings so your family rests with complete peace of mind.

reviews.title: What Pilgrims Say About Their Stay
reviews.googleBadge: Rated 4.8 / 5 on Google Reviews by over 250+ Devotees
reviews.review1Quote: Hotel Morya is the most convenient place to stay in Admapur. Being just 200 metres from Balumama Temple, my aged parents could attend both morning and evening aarti without exhaustion. The ground-floor accessibility and 24-hour hot water made our stay effortless.
reviews.review2Quote: Spotless rooms and extremely polite management. After driving 6 hours from Pune, stepping into a cool AC room with fresh bedsheets was such a relief. We also booked the dormitory for our extended family group, and everyone was thrilled.
reviews.review3Quote: The safe car parking and proximity to the temple dining hall are major advantages. Very quiet and peaceful atmosphere at night, allowing us to rest peacefully after darshan.
